usage: xo audit [--dir=<dir>] [--json] [--no-gc] [<dir>]

Supply chain report (decision 0156): per dependency its version, the
effects its API may reach, its xo.lock effects line, its effect ceiling,
and its escape hatches (use c, use go of an impure package) with the
vouch that covers each; this module's attenuations and the capabilities
it passes into dependencies; and the check's diagnostics. JSON when
--json or stdout is not a terminal. Exit 1 when the check has errors.
--no-gc checks as a native build (use c).

A directory means that directory alone; DIR/... covers the directories
below it too, up to 6,000 .xo files or 60,000 entries (decision 0345).
A DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
